drhp.business:
The company is a civil engineering, manufacturing and construction company engaged in manufacturing and dealing of Pre-Stressed Concrete (PSC) sleepers for railways and precast/prestressed concrete products, and in fabrication and erection of Mild Steel (MS) Pipes, MS Liner and Penstock Pipes for Pumped Storage Projects (PSP). Its business has a Manufacturing segment and a Services segment: the Sleeper Division was 42.61% (Government) and 20.92% (Private) of Fiscal 2026 Revenue from Operations; the MS Pipe Division was 11.11% (Private); Total Manufacturing Vertical was 75.01%. The Services Vertical, including Subcontract & Jobwork at 23.90%, was 24.99% of Fiscal 2026 revenue. Revenue from Operations was ₹33,867.73 lakhs in Fiscal 2026 and ₹24,288.20 lakhs in Fiscal 2024; net profit was ₹2,497.50 lakhs in Fiscal 2026 and ₹344.56 lakhs in Fiscal 2024.

The largest customer, Indian Railways, accounted for 40.56% of Fiscal 2026 revenue; the top 5 customers were 85.33% and the top 10 customers were 92.91% of Fiscal 2026 revenue. Revenue from repeat customers was 95.13% of Fiscal 2026 revenue. By state, Maharashtra was 35.52%, Madhya Pradesh 33.96% and Gujarat 17.90% of Fiscal 2026 revenue.

For PSC sleepers, it manufactures broad gauge (BG), meter gauge (MG) and standard gauge sleepers using high-tensile steel wires/strands tensioned before casting concrete, with tension released after the concrete achieves strength, followed by steam curing; it can manufacture mono-block, twin-block and turnout sleepers under the same facility. Its primary MS Pipes product is hot-rolled MS Pipes up to 7,500 diameter, thickness 3 mm to 36 mm, fabricated onsite by automatic longitudinal submerged arc welding, with anti-corrosive coatings such as sand blasting, painting, and cement mortar lining & guniting. It also manufactures precast noise barriers and cable ducts for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor for Larsen & Toubro, Limited at its Nadiad, Gujarat facility. Services include sub-contracting job work for Samruddhi Industries, Kalpataru Projects International Limited and Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Private Limited, power generation through windmills of 1.8 MW combined capacity, scrap sale, and leasing income including a Build-Operate-Transfer Scheme in Solapur with the Solapur Municipal Corporation. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certifications at its Bankhedi, Kandrori, Mohol and Raigad units and for MS Pipes at Kukshi, and ISO 45001:2018 at Kukshi.

As a manufacturer of PSC sleepers, our scope of services, product specifications, delivery schedules and unit rates, are primarily determined by the periodic purchase orders issued under a tender awarded by the respective zonal segments of the Indian Railways or on a sub-contracting basis from private parties who are awarded tenders from government owned public- sector undertakings such as the DFCCIL.
We depend significantly on a certain number of customers for our business and revenue.
A substantial decrease in the orders placed on us by these customers or a decrease in the demand of these products may adversely impact our revenues and profitability.

Our total revenue generated from our manufacturing and service business are predominantly derived from certain number of customers including but not limited to Northern Railways, Central Railways, North Central Railways, West Central Railways, Larsen & Toubro, Limited, Samruddhi Industries, Kalpataru Projects International Limited, ISC Projects Limited, and Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Private Limited.

overview.business_model:
The company is a civil engineering, manufacturing and construction company engaged in manufacturing and dealing of Pre-Stressed Concrete (PSC) sleepers for railways and precast/prestressed concrete products, and in fabrication and erection of Mild Steel (MS) Pipes, MS Liner and Penstock Pipes for Pumped Storage Projects (PSP). Its business has a Manufacturing segment and a Services segment: the Sleeper Division was 42.61% (Government) and 20.92% (Private) of Fiscal 2026 Revenue from Operations; the MS Pipe Division was 11.11% (Private); Total Manufacturing Vertical was 75.01%. The Services Vertical, including Subcontract & Jobwork at 23.90%, was 24.99% of Fiscal 2026 revenue. Revenue from Operations was ₹33,867.73 lakhs in Fiscal 2026 and ₹24,288.20 lakhs in Fiscal 2024; net profit was ₹2,497.50 lakhs in Fiscal 2026 and ₹344.56 lakhs in Fiscal 2024.

The largest customer, Indian Railways, accounted for 40.56% of Fiscal 2026 revenue; the top 5 customers were 85.33% and the top 10 customers were 92.91% of Fiscal 2026 revenue. Revenue from repeat customers was 95.13% of Fiscal 2026 revenue. By state, Maharashtra was 35.52%, Madhya Pradesh 33.96% and Gujarat 17.90% of Fiscal 2026 revenue.

For PSC sleepers, it manufactures broad gauge (BG), meter gauge (MG) and standard gauge sleepers using high-tensile steel wires/strands tensioned before casting concrete, with tension released after the concrete achieves strength, followed by steam curing; it can manufacture mono-block, twin-block and turnout sleepers under the same facility. Its primary MS Pipes product is hot-rolled MS Pipes up to 7,500 diameter, thickness 3 mm to 36 mm, fabricated onsite by automatic longitudinal submerged arc welding, with anti-corrosive coatings such as sand blasting, painting, and cement mortar lining & guniting. It also manufactures precast noise barriers and cable ducts for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor for Larsen & Toubro, Limited at its Nadiad, Gujarat facility. Services include sub-contracting job work for Samruddhi Industries, Kalpataru Projects International Limited and Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Private Limited, power generation through windmills of 1.8 MW combined capacity, scrap sale, and leasing income including a Build-Operate-Transfer Scheme in Solapur with the Solapur Municipal Corporation. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certifications at its Bankhedi, Kandrori, Mohol and Raigad units and for MS Pipes at Kukshi, and ISO 45001:2018 at Kukshi.
